paper.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
truncated_sections: B.5 Performance Variance and Pass@k Rate

result.summary: 本文研究界面设计如何影响语言模型智能体在软件工程任务上的表现，并提出 SWE-agent 系统，通过为 LM 智能体定制 agent-computer interface（ACI）来提升其能力 [abstract][S1.p1]。SWE-agent 的 ACI 提供查看、搜索、编辑文件等简单动作，并配有护栏和简洁反馈 [S1.p3]。在 SWE-bench 和 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 分别取得 12.5% 和 87.7% 的 pass@1 成绩，超过此前非交互式 LM 的最佳结果 [abstract]。消融实验表明，SWE-agent 在 SWE-bench Lite 上比仅使用默认 Linux shell 的基线多解决 10.7 个百分点 [S1.p4]。作者认为，精心设计的 ACI 能在不修改底层 LM 权重的情况下显著提升智能体性能 [S1.p5]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：如何设计适合语言模型智能体的计算机接口，以提升其在软件工程等复杂任务上的表现 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。作者指出，现有接口是为人类用户设计的，而 LM 智能体代表一类新的终端用户，具有自身需求与能力 [S2.p1]。研究动机在于，LM 智能体直接使用 Linux shell 等现有应用时难以可靠行动，例如无法简单编辑小段文件，且无效编辑没有反馈，这些缺陷严重阻碍性能 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.
We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.
In practice, we find that LM agents can struggle to reliably take actions in this environment.
These deficits substantially hamper performance, motivating the need for an agent-computer interface (ACI)

method.text: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的系统，使 LM 能自主使用计算机解决软件工程任务 [S1.p3]。其 ACI 提供一小组简单动作，用于查看、搜索和编辑文件，并利用护栏防止常见错误，每轮向智能体返回具体简洁的反馈 [S1.p3]。ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，智能体每步生成一个 thought 和一个 command，并纳入执行反馈 [S3.p1]。设计过程采用两种方式：人工检查智能体行为以发现问题并提出改进，以及网格搜索选择最佳 ACI 配置 [S2.p4]。

evidence.quote: we introduce SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
SWE-agent’s ACI instead offers a small set of simple actions for viewing, searching through and editing files.
The ACI uses guardrails to prevent common mistakes, and an agent receives specific, concise feedback about a command’s effects at every turn.
The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
At each step, SWE-agent generates a thought and a command, then incorporates the feedback from the command’s execution in the environment

We use two approaches to enhance performance on a development set: (1) manually inspect agent behavior to identify difficulties and propose improvements, and (2) run a grid search to select the best ACI configuration.

experiments.text: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 数据集上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个流行 Python 包的 2,294 个任务实例；消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite 的 300 个实例上进行 [S4.p1]。此外还用 HumanEvalFix 测试 SWE-agent 的基本代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。所有结果、消融和分析基于 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。基线包括非交互式检索增强生成（RAG）和仅使用 Linux shell 的 Shell-only 设置 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。主要指标为 % Resolved 或 pass@1，并报告平均 API 推理成本，单实例预算设为 4 美元 [S4.p5]。

evidence.quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench that focus on evaluating self-contained functional bug fixes.
We also test SWE-agent’s basic code editing abilities with HumanEvalFix, a short-form code debugging benchmark.
All results, ablations, and analyses are based on two leading LMs, GPT-4 Turbo ( gpt-4-1106-preview) and Claude 3 Opus ( claude-3-opus-20240229).
The first setting is the non-interactive, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines established in.
The second setting, called Shell-only, is adapted from the interactive coding framework introduced in.
We report % Resolved or pass $@$ $1$ as the main metric
Due to budget constraints, we set the per-instance budget to $4; if a run exceeded this budget, existing edits were submitted automatically.

findings.text: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo 在所有系统中表现最佳，解决了完整 SWE-bench 测试集的 12.47%（286/2,294）和 Lite 子集的 18.00%（54/300）[S5.p1]。相比 Lite 上的 RAG，SWE-agent 成本高 8–13 倍，但 % Resolved 率提升 6.7 倍；相比 Shell-only，相对提升 64% [S5.p1]。在 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 取得 88.3% 的 pass@1 率 [S5.p2]。消融实验显示，SWE-agent 比仅使用默认 Linux shell 的基线多解决 10.7 个百分点 [S1.p4]。此外，SWE-agent 的 ACI 可迁移到不同 LM，使用 Claude 3 Opus 可解决 10.5% 的基准任务 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
compared to RAG on Lite, SWE-agent is $8$ - $13$ x more costly but yields a $6.7$ -fold improved % Resolved rate.
An LM-friendly ACI’s value is confirmed by SWE-agent’s $64$ % relative increase compared to Shell-only, both with GPT-4 Turbo.
SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.
The results show that SWE-agent solves $10.7$ percentage points more instances than the baseline agent, which uses only the default Linux shell.
SWE-agent with Claude 3 Opus can solve $10.5$ % of the benchmark tasks.
